# Owen Sound Heating & Cooling

> Owen Sound Heating & Cooling provides heating and cooling service to homeowners in and around Owen Sound, Grey County, Ontario. The team handles furnace and AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump service, gas fireplace work, thermostat upgrades, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (548) 409-5669  |  Email: contact@owensoundheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://owensoundheatingcooling.ca
